title: Approved person cards across Network and Discover
summary: Implement the approved fixed-size, permission-aware person-card design with saved collaboration, published portfolio evidence, measured skills and relationship footers, retaining existing mutation handlers and page/message layouts.
dataSourcesChanged: One bounded optional metadata batch per returned feed/application page: saved availability, canonical public skills (legacy saved profile labels only when no assignments exist), public contribution portfolio and live permitted mutuals.
On-demand paged shared-person read revalidates target access.
Add nullable connections.accepted_at with a transition trigger; preserve unknown historical dates. No existing connection history is rewritten.
concurrencyRisk: Keep sort/cursor keys and existing relationship transactions. Resolve optional metadata for the bounded result page, exclude blocked/deleted/self recommendations, mask locked metadata, recheck target access after shared-person reads, lock duplicate decisions, propagate failed Connect results and retain review failures. Capture acceptance at the database transition for single/bulk writers, prevent later edits from changing it, clear it when the relationship ends. Preserve unknown on read failures. No per-card polling, timer dates or Messages changes.

rollback.strategy: Revert only this presentation/projection change set. Keep the additive nullable timestamp column/trigger and recorded migration; do not erase relationship data or reset pre-existing workspace changes.
validation: Existing connection and application actions still work
No private portfolio or skill edges leak
Unknown legacy dates still render Connected
